description_en: Queries the distribution status of data files on edge instances of an application
description_zh: 调用DescribeDataDistResult获取数据文件在应用边缘资源实例的分发状态结果
kebab_example: aliyun ens describe-data-dist-result --app-id e76f8985-7965-41fc-925b-9648bb6bf650 --data-names cloudgame-shanghai/deploy_app/20220215/1644895216305ACG_M21B-ota-1.1.2-D-0215.0628_V1_0002-pre-weiduan.zip --data-versions 4885 --instance-ids i-7ecpqvkicnchxccozrp,i-6ecpqvkicnchxccozrp --min-date 2022-01-02 --max-date 2022-02-01 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --ens-region-ids cn-xiangyang-19 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDataDistResult

parameters.help_en: The name of the data file. Separate multiple names with commas (,). By default, all data files are queried
parameters.help_zh: 数据文件名；属于查询的过滤条件，支持多选，以","号分割；默认查询所有
parameters.name: data_names

parameters.help_en: The version number of the data file. Separate multiple numbers with commas (,). By default, all versions of data files are queried
parameters.help_zh: 数据文件版本号；属于查询的过滤条件，支持多选，以","号分割；默认查询所有
parameters.name: data_versions

parameters.help_en: The IDs of ENS instances. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). By default, all instances are queried
parameters.help_zh: 边缘实例ID列表；属于查询的过滤条件，支持多选，以","号分割；默认查询所有
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the 2006-01-02 format. By default, the time range to query is not restricted
parameters.help_zh: 查询起始时间，格式"2006-01-02"；默认无时间限制
parameters.name: min_date

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the 2006-01-02 format. By default, the time range to query is not restricted
parameters.help_zh: 查询终止时间，格式"2006-01-02"；默认无时间限制
parameters.name: max_date

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. This parameter is optional if you want to return the push status of all data files
parameters.help_zh: 页码，起始值为1，导出全部信息时可不传入
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. This parameter is optional if you want to return the distribution status of all data files
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，导出全部时可不传入
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the ENS nodes
parameters.name: ens_region_ids

DistResult.description_en: The distribution status of data files on edge instances
DistResult.description_zh: 边缘资源实例的数据分发状态列表

items.description_en: The data distribution status of edge resource instances
items.description_zh: 边缘资源实例的数据分发状态

Name.description_en: The name of the data file

InstanceCount.description_en: The number of associated edge instances
InstanceCount.description_zh: 关联的边缘资源实例数量

Instance.description_en: The distribution status of the edge instance
Instance.description_zh: 边缘资源实例的分发状态列表

items.description_en: The distribution status of edge resource instances
items.description_zh: 边缘资源实例的分发状态

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the distribution. The time is displayed in UTC
StartTime.description_zh: 分发开始时间，UTC时间格式

StatusDescrip.description_en: The description of the distribution status

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the distribution status was last updated. The time is displayed in UTC
UpdateTime.description_zh: 状态的最新更新时间，utc时间

Status.description_en:
The distribution status. The value is of the enumeration type. Valid values:

SUCCESS: The distribution is successful.

FAILED: The distribution failed.

DISTING: The data is being distributed.

POD_RESTARTING: The idle pod is being restarted.

DELETED: The data is cleared or removed
Status.description_zh:
分发状态。枚举类型，取值：

SUCCESS：已分发成功
FAILED：分发失败
DISTING：数据分发中
POD_RESTARTING: 重启空闲POD中
DELETED: 数据已清理/下架

Version.description_en: The version number of the data file

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
